decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks remain closely linked to the firm's dental thermoforming and materials know-how, so its absorptive capacity still supports refinement and retention despite missing later website evidence.

The PETG thermoforming blank sits in the core of the firm's established dental materials business, making withdrawal relatively unlikely because existing production knowledge, quality routines, and channels can continue to sustain it.

UV-curing lacquer is technically related to the firm's materials expertise but is less central and less visibly established than the other launches, so it remains the most exposed to portfolio rationalisation even though the firm can still learn and improve it.
Intraoral contrast spray fits the firm's push toward digital dental workflows, and that strategic fit gives management good scope to interpret user feedback and keep the product in the range.
The custom earmold line builds directly on the firm's long-standing hearing-care custom manufacturing capabilities, so accumulated design and production knowledge argues for keeping it.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are a related extension of the firm's earmold expertise and channel relationships, so they are still likely to be retained, though their somewhat more adjacent positioning leaves more uncertainty than core hearing products.
